
## Input

Use a `GRNData` object with paired RNA/ATAC cells, regulatory regions, gene annotation, and motif matches from `find_motifs()`.

## Fit condition-comparable GRNs

```r
fit_object <- infer_condition_grn(
  grn_object,
  cell_type_col = "cell_type",
  condition_col = "condition",
  genes = metabolic_genes,
  min_cells_per_condition = 300L,
  parallel = TRUE
)
```

Main defaults are `tf_cor = 0.05`, `peak_cor = 0.05`, `padj_threshold = 0.05`, `rank_action = "mark"`, and `min_residual_df = 1L`. Multi-condition cell types use one exact common TF-peak-target dictionary with condition-specific no-fusion ridge coefficients. Fewer than two condition levels select standard Pando fallback.

Advanced ridge tuning is passed directly:

```r
fit_object <- infer_condition_grn(
  grn_object,
  cell_type_col = "cell_type",
  condition_col = "condition",
  condition_ridge_control = list(
    cv_folds = 5L,
    lambda_rule = "lambda.min",
    seed = 1L
  )
)
```

`fallback_args` is reserved for arguments used only by standard Pando fallback; condition ridge controls are not nested inside it.

## Outputs

Retrieve the fitted cell-type contract and one condition subgraph with:

```r
fit <- condition_grn_fit(fit_object, cell_type = "T_cell")
edges <- condition_grn_subgraph(
  fit,
  condition = "Control",
  significant_only = TRUE
)
```

The coefficient table contains the common edge identity, condition-specific ridge estimate, uncertainty/statistical fields, candidate-support provenance, `active`, and `penalty_effect`. `fit$fit$rsq` is the selected-lambda final full-data target R-squared; `rsq_oof` is the out-of-fold diagnostic.

## Projection

```r
projection <- project_condition_grn_cells(
  fit_object,
  fit = fit,
  significant_only = TRUE
)

metacell_projection <- aggregate_condition_grn_projection(
  projection,
  membership,
  group_col = "metacell_id"
)
```

`membership` must map each paired cell ID to exactly one aggregation group. See the Rd pages for the full current parameter and output contracts.
